🎯 Quadratic Equations一元二次方程

Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法

If two numbers multiply to zero, one of them must be zero. That single fact solves most quadratic equations on your test in two lines.两个数相乘等于零，其中至少一个是零。就凭这一条，考卷上大多数一元二次方程两行就能解完。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法
  1. Zero product: get 0 on one side FIRST, then set each factor =0.零积法则：先让一边等于 0，再令每个因式 =0。
  2. (…)2=k: take ±k​; k<0 → no real solution.(…)2=k：开方取 ±k​；k<0 → 无实数解。
  3. Never divide by x: factor it out, or the root x=0 is lost.不要两边除以 x：把 x 提出来，否则丢掉根 x=0。
AB=0 ⇒ A=0 or B=0
(x−p)2=k ⇒ x=p±k​(k≥0)

🧗 The hard part难点 · Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法

Making it =0 before factoring分解前先化成 =0

A factored left side looks finished, so students set each bracket equal to the right side.左边已经是因式形式，看着像做完了，于是把每个括号设成等于右边的数。

  1. (x+1)(x−4)=6: right side =0, so stop(x+1)(x−4)=6：右边不是 0，先别拆
  2. x2−3x−4−6=0⇒x2−3x−10=0
  3. (x−5)(x+2)=0⇒x=5, −2
  4. Check x=5: (6)(1)=6验 x=5：(6)(1)=6

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Solving by factoring & square roots因式分解法与直接开平方法
  • x(x−3)=10⇒x=10 or x−3=10 → expand: x2−3x−10=0, x=5,−2.x(x−3)=10⇒x=10 或 x−3=10 → 先展开：x2−3x−10=0，x=5,−2。
  • x2=49⇒x=7 → x=±7.x2=49⇒x=7 → 应为 x=±7。

cards.f: First move for 5x2=20x?5x2=20x 第一步？

quiz.q: A square photo is enlarged by adding 3 cm to each side. The new area is 121 cm². Find the original side length.一张正方形照片每边加长 3 cm 后面积为 121 cm²。求原来的边长。

quiz.q: A rectangular community garden in Burnaby is 12 m by 8 m. The city wants to double its area by adding a strip of the same width to the length and the width. A councillor says a 3 m strip is enough. (a) Is she right? (b) What strip width does double the area?本拿比一块长方形社区菜园长 12 m、宽 8 m。市政府想把长和宽各加同样宽的一条，使面积翻倍。一位议员说加 3 m 就够。(a) 她对吗？(b) 要加多宽才能使面积翻倍？
quiz.hint: Doubled area is 192. Let the strip be x and write (12+x)(8+x)=192.面积翻倍是 192。设加宽 x，列 (12+x)(8+x)=192。
quiz.ans: (a) No: 15×11=165<192. (b) 4 m.(a) 不对：15×11=165<192。(b) 4 m。
quiz.why: (a) With x=3: 15×11=165=192, so she is wrong.(a) x=3 时：15×11=165=192，所以她不对。
